notes.title: Playtest Now Live – The Fourth Sense Evolution
notes.content:
[p][b]About the game[/b]
You play as a god guiding the evolution of a worm-like creature and shaping its world. It’s a sandbox strategy game inspired by [i]Spore[/i] and [i]RimWorld[/i], where you can experiment with evolution, survival, and world-building in unique ways.[/p][p][b]How to join[/b][/p][list][*][p]Click the [b]Request Access[/b] button on the store page to join the playtest.[/p][/*][*][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/8wNHJ3GeQK"]Discord community[/url] to share feedback and connect with other players.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Note:[/b] The playtest is [b]Windows only[/b] for now. A Mac version will be available later.[/p]
